Also, Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act of 1966 (P.L. 89-665) requires certain procedures prior to any Federal action that might affect a property listed in the National Register of Historic Places. We believe that the subject statement should indicate whether compliance with Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act will be assured during implementation of E. O. 11644.
We appreciate having an opportunity to review the subject draft environmental statement, and we offer you our comments in a spirit of assisting you in complying with requirements of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969.
Thereor Q. Swern
